subject: Initial vendor evidence request: modern slavery & diversity documentation
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@acme-logistics.com>, Acme Logistics Compliance <compliance@acme-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial vendor evidence request: modern slavery & diversity documentation

Hi Jordan / Acme compliance team,

Thanks for completing the account setup call yesterday — excited to get Acme onboarded. To keep procurement moving and unblock PO creation from our side we need a short set of documents that feed into our vendor code and risk screen. Can you please provide the following by end of day Tuesday (US Pacific)?

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached) — includes billing remit and W-9/SSN fields (if applicable).
- Supplier Diversity survey (attached) — completes our DEI supplier scoring.
- Modern Slavery / Human Trafficking statement or policy (PDF preferred).
- Primary contact for procurement and AP (name, title, email, phone).
- Estimated lead time for future purchase orders and any minimum order values.

If any of these items need a different internal contact at Acme, please let us know and loop them in. Once we receive the PDFs and the completed spreadsheet, Marissa will create the initial PO request and Connor will route the vendor code for approval.

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx, supplier_diversity_survey.pdf

Quick ask: if you have a public link to your modern slavery statement (e.g., on your website or compliance portal), pasting that URL in a reply is fine instead of sending a PDF.

Cheers,

Hannah Schmitt
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

--

- Lead time for standard hardware orders is typically 4–6 weeks; software/integration services are on a case-by-case basis.

We attached the modern slavery statement and a one-page compliance summary. Vendor onboarding spreadsheet looks straightforward — we'll return that filled out by Monday.

Thanks for the ping — confirmed receipt of Acme's modern slavery statement and compliance card. A few internal notes and next steps:

- Vendor code: procurement will generate a provisional vendor code once we have the filled onboarding spreadsheet and W-9 (or equivalent). Provisional codes allow PO issuance for low-risk purchases up to $10k.
- PO process: use PO template PO-STD-HW-2023 (I will attach the template to the procurement ticket). For orders > $25k we require a three-approver workflow.
- Diversity certificate: we do not need the notarized government registry document to issue a provisional PO, but we must have the certificate on file before an ARR/contract is signed or before any committed spend over $50k.
- Risk/ESG: I will run the policy through our risk engine and flag any items that require legal review. If legal requests redlines to the MSA, procurement will pause full PO issuance until approved.

Jordan — can you attach the completed supplier_diversity_survey.pdf (fillable form) and the vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx when they're available? Also please confirm AP invoice email (ap@acme-logistics.com) so we can add remit instructions to the PO.

Related ticket: https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-987 (procurement: vendor onboarding — Acme Logistics)

Thanks,
Connor O'brien
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0189
